intro.text: The Poem of Ista is an ancient Rosharan poem by an unknown author. An excerpt from it is quoted in an epigraph.

description.text: The excerpt tells of someone, called only "he", who carries a Dawnshard, said to be able to bind any creature, up enormous steps built for Heralds toward a temple.
The note with the excerpt remarks that Dawnshards turn up often in early myths but are mostly ignored by modern scholars.
